title: Interlock Logic & Cause Effect Matrix - LV-6701 (SEQ-6701)
content:
INTERLOCK LOGIC & CAUSE EFFECT MATRIX: SEQ-6701 (LP SEPARATOR LEVEL PROTECTION (FA-6710 / LV-6701) LOGIC).
Document No: TJC-LLD-IL-LV-6701, Revision: Rev 3, SIL Level: SIL 1.
Equipment: LV-6701, Functional Location: TJC-LLD-6700-01.
CAUSE & EFFECT MATRIX (TRIPS):
- T1: Separator level HIGH-HIGH (LSHH-6710 > 85 %, 1oo2) -> Actions: Open Fully (EFF-1), DCS Alarm (EFF-4)
- T2: Separator level LOW-LOW (LSLL-6710 < 15 %, 1oo2) -> Actions: Close (EFF-2), DCS Alarm (EFF-4)
- T3: ESD activation (manual) (HS-6701 ESD signal, 1oo1) -> Actions: Vent Actuator (EFF-3), DCS Alarm (EFF-4)
- T4: Instrument air pressure LOW (PSL-6702 < 1.0 barg, 1oo1) -> Actions: Vent Actuator (EFF-3), DCS Alarm (EFF-4)
START PERMISSIVES (AND-gate conditions to start pump):
- P1: Instrument air available (> 1.2 barg) (PI-6702, Gate Logic: AND)
- P2: Positioner DVC6200 in AUTO/healthy (DVC6200, Gate Logic: AND)
- P3: Bypass HV-6701 closed (normal operation) (HV-6701, Gate Logic: AND)
- —: ALL permissives TRUE → START LV-6701 ENABLED (—, Gate Logic: AND)
CROSS REFERENCES: P&ID: TJC-LLD-PID-6701, Datasheet: TJC-LLD-DS-LV-6701.
